1933, August
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 137 Cont.
Aug. 29th Baby Edgar Picard - 172 mo. - sick since Nov. - Flu - measles - double pneumonia - now seems to have abcesses on lungs - only child left of 3.
Anna Risco (Mrs.)- 67 - breast removed last Tuesday, getting along well, anxious ...
Mary Bernies - 86 - 8 yrs. invalid complains not being able to die - cancer of intestines - son away ..... 30 yrs.
Marie Colombo - 20 mo. - never spoke so far - mother not to Easter duty .. ...
Jos. T. - 7 - losing sight in one eye.
Carmen Borg - 42 - E. Malta - brain-tumor - weak after operation. Blank Page
1933, September
Page 138 Page 139 Sept.
Ellen DeMaggi - 3 - Infantile paral's
Norman Laskowski - 9 - had "flu" now blind in one eye - Mother asks prayers for ....
2nd
Sat. Mrs. Fr. LaBell - 24 - convert - blood-poison - hopeless - quite given up ...
Joseph Ciak - 7, a twin - like paralized - unable to sit up, talk or stand, improving.
Mrs. Fr. LaBelle - 24 -
Henry Laethem - 57 - Enemic ... now home from Rochester ... improving. Robert Mross - 5 - Speechless, except "Mama - Papa".
Walter Kopydlowski - 26 - T.B. Weak, without finance, wandering a- way from home when ought to be in bed. Father atheist - mother broken hearted pleads for prayers .. ....
C.J. Archambeau - 48 of near Cleveland, 0. - hopelessly paralized since a yr. ago. Married out, non Cath. by a priest, Grandmother insisting on protestant baptism ... has not been to sacraments since ...
Lucille Knopes - 14 - improving had 280 Bl.p. still in danger - kidney trouble serious.
